label: MEASURED against the frozen filter. Do not wire the corpus sign convention to nflverse columns.
filter: REG 2017 W1 - 2026 W5, n=2462, margin = home_score - away_score
claim_under_test: The research corpus states, in at least 8 places across PREDICTION_ENGINE_MASTER (1).md, PREDICTION_ENGINE_MASTER (2).md, GSE_HANDOFF_PACK_2026-10-10 (1).md, GSE_MASTER_PACK_2026-10-10 (1).md and gse-deep-nfl-methods-corpus-2026.md: 'listed_spread = the book's HOME number (favorite negative); mu_margin = -listed_spread'.
verdict: The formula is CORRECT for a book's home-number feed and WRONG for nflverse spread_line. Wiring it to this repo's data column silently inverts the prediction.

mu_equals_MINUS_spread_line.note: the corpus convention applied to nflverse columns

why: nflverse spread_line is the AWAY team's number. Positive spread_line means the away team is favoured, so expected home margin is +spread_line, not -spread_line.

evidence_row.reading: KC (away) favoured by 8, won by 15. Expected home margin +8 vs realized -15 is the correct error. mu = -8 would have predicted NE by 8 against a 15-point KC win.

cover_check.note: With mu = +spread_line the favourite covers at 56.3% before de-vig, consistent with a correctly-oriented line.

actionable: Any engine code adopting mu_margin = -listed_spread MUST first assert which team the incoming spread refers to. Do not copy the formula without that check.
The team-total split (game_total +/- mu_margin)/2 inherits the same dependency; the corpus already notes the original (T+spread)/2 was a real sign error.

injury_adj and situational_adj in the corpus add drops/adj to listed_spread. Those are fine as BOOK-spread adjustments, but must not be applied to spread_line and then fed as mu without the sign flip.

corpus_audit_summary.note: 179 of 182 were checker false-positives: citations carrying line refs like 'file.md:L22' do not string-match a bare filename. Only 3 real cases: GSE_MIND_LEAP_2026-10-03 (1).md cited without being read, and a wildcard citation 'GSE/GSE/firecrawl_activity_logs*.csv'. The swarm did not fabricate citations at scale.
